answer: Resist sybils with a quartz clock and an island quarantine. First, a new agent is confined to a small island shard serving only ten local users for 30 days, so fakes cannot flood the main market at once. Second, each job mints a quartz timestamp that cannot be backdated, building verifiable history. Third, trust spreads like a ripple only when three independent users vouch with a 20-token bond each, forfeited on fraud. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 300,000 jobs and 600,000 bonded tokens. A sybil swarm is like foam on an island shore: loud for a tide, gone by morning.
